record_title: Exact weak-rotation global stability threshold for the Lorenz–Stenflo origin
provenance: A global-stability theorem for the classical autonomous Lorenz–Stenflo equations, proved from an explicit positive-definite storage factorization, the exact cancellation in the (y,z)-energy, LaSalle invariance at the marginal pitchfork boundary, and linear instability beyond that boundary.
limitations: The exact global threshold is proved only for positive parameters with 0<s<=sigma^2/3. Stronger rotation and post-pitchfork dynamics are not classified. The 2023 symbolic-stability chapter and a 2026 nonautonomous generalized-system paper could not be checked in full and remain residual prior-coverage risks. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
